title: Selling pianos and player pianos at Werlein's
summary: Player piano prices, Ted Frank, Dave Frank, rolls and winning a shotgun for sales.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: We were talking about piano tuning and Whirlions. I've forgotten how long you were at Whirlions.

I have been on and off at Whirlions since 1926. That's before my time. Ted Frank I knew when he was four years old. Ted was four when I first went to work at Whirlions. Ted's been very very sick but he's recovering. Ted had a terrible heart condition. He lost oh some 40-50 pounds.
What did you do in 26 when you went to Whirlions?
Ted's been very sick. I sold pianos. What did they sell for back then? I wonder.
Ted's been very sick. One of the best sellers was a player piano sold for $333.
Ted's been very sick. You know who made it?
Ted's been very sick. Aeolian American. It was the Bear Brothers. B-E-H-R. Ted's been very sick. Today's player pianos sell for nearly $4,000.
Ted's been very sick. Who uh...
Ted's been very sick. Well look at today's Ford.
Ted's been very sick. That's true.
Ted's been very sick. $350 was the price of a model T Ford.

Ted's been very sick. What about the Rolls? Did they sell the Rolls in the piano department? Ted's been very sick. Oh yes. Ted's been very sick. They sold right there together? Ted's been very sick. I was wondering about how the place was set up.
Ted's been very sick. No, no. I take it back. Dave Frank sold the Rolls. Now, with each piano you got 25 Rolls. I see. So... Ted's been one of those shotguns in there. I won selling player pianos.
Who gave that to you? The Whirlands or the company?

No, the company. Aeolian? Yeah. I think it was Aeolian, yeah. Could have been. I also won a suede jacket for Ellen at the time. I won the shotgun for me and the suede jacket for so many points for selling so many pianos.
